info.name: Google Gemini Content Generation API
info.description:
Google's Gemini API provides access to generative AI models for text generation, multimodal understanding, and embedding creation. The API supports text, image, audio, and video inputs with configurable safety settings, generation parameters, and tool use capabilities.

Contact Support:
 Name: Google AI Developer Support

item.name: Google Gemini Generates a model response given an input GenerateContentRequest.

request.description: Generates a response from the model given an input. The input can include text, images, audio, video, and other multimodal content. The model processes the input according to its capabilities and returns generated content along with safety ratings and usage metadata.

response.name: Successful response with generated content.
Bad request. The request body is malformed or missing required fields.
Unauthorized. Invalid or missing API key.
Forbidden. The API key does not have permission to access the requested model.
Not found. The specified model does not exist.
Too many requests. Rate limit exceeded.

item.name: Google Gemini Generates a streamed response from the model given an input…

query.description: Set to 'sse' for server-sent events streaming.

request.description: Generates a streamed response from the model. This endpoint behaves identically to generateContent but returns partial responses incrementally as server-sent events. Each event contains a GenerateContentResponse with one or more candidate content parts. Use the alt=sse query parameter to enable streaming.

response.name: Successful streaming response. Returns a stream of GenerateContentResponse objects as server-sent events.
